_comment: The CURRENT polyglot exhibits (not the stale purepy polyglot-pythia-showcases rows). Python = purescript-python examples on 8081/8082 (ports chosen to dodge SDI; dir was renamed from purescript-python-new); julia = Jurist stability-atlas; site = polyglot website, now served by polyglot-deploy/static-httpd (a single Go binary, no python/npx on the target — build it once: `cd polyglot-deploy/static-httpd && go build -o static-httpd main.go`).

servers._comment: The local-with-edge front door: satisfies the website artifact's topology contract (same-origin /ee /ge /atlas) for the no-Docker MBP deploy, mirroring the Lua edge container on the mini. Lazy reverse-proxy (proxies per request) so boot order is non-critical; listed last. Defaults: /->:3040 website, /ee*->:8081, /ge*->:8082, /atlas*->:3210.
